instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her mom have a picnic in the park, but it starts to rain. Lily borrows an umbrella from her friend Johnny and they have a great time playing and eating.
With: happy ending
response:
When they got to the park, they spread out a blanket and started to eat. Suddenly, it started to rain. Lily's mom said, "Oh no, we forgot to bring an umbrella." Lily said, "I can borrow one from my friend Johnny." 
After they finished eating, Lily and her mom went to Johnny's house. Johnny was happy to lend them his umbrella. They walked back to the park, and the rain stopped. They had a great time playing and eating, and Lily wasn't hungry anymore. When they returned the umbrella to Johnny, he said, "Thanks for returning it. You're a good friend."
Summary: Lily and her mom have a picnic in the park, but it starts to rain. Lily borrows an umbrella from her friend Johnny and they have a great time playing and eating.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim meets a cat on his way to visit his friend Sam and invites him along, but the cat ends up killing a bird and leaving, teaching Tim a lesson about making new friends.
With: sad ending
response:
On the way, Tim met a big cat. The cat said, "Hello, where are you going?" Tim replied, "I am going to visit my friend Sam." The cat said, "Can I come too?" Tim thought about it and said, "Yes, you can come."
As they walked, the cat saw a bird and ran after it. Tim tried to stop the cat, but he could not. The cat caught the bird and ate it. Tim was sad and the cat left. He learned that not all new friends are good friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A father and daughter play together in the garden and decide to shoot targets. The daughter becomes frustrated when she can't hit any, but her father encourages her to keep practicing until she succeeds.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a daddy and his daughter. Every day they would go in the garden and play together. One day they decided to shoot some targets. It was difficult but they kept trying.
The daughter was very excited when she hit her first target. She cheered and hugged her daddy. She kept trying and soon she was shooting them all!
Then one day it was very difficult. She just couldn't seem to hit any of the targets. She became angry and sad.
But daddy said to her, "Don't worry! We will keep practicing and you will get better!"
The daughter smiled and kept trying. And in the end she was able to shoot them all! She was so happy, and daddy was proud of her.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy watches a big machine dig a hole for a swimming pool and discovers a treasure chest which he gets to keep.
With: happy ending
response:
He asked his mom, "What's that big machine doing in our backyard?" 
His mom replied, "It's here to dig a big hole for our new swimming pool." 
Timmy was excited and asked, "Can I watch it dig?" 
His mom permitted him to watch from a safe distance. 
As Timmy watched the machine dig, he started feeling tired. He yawned and rubbed his eyes. Suddenly, the machine hit something hard and stopped. Everyone gathered around to see what happened. The machine had hit a treasure chest! Timmy was thrilled and his mom permitted him to keep the treasure. From that day on, Timmy's toy cars and trucks had a new treasure to play with.
Summary: Timmy watches a big machine dig a hole for a swimming pool and discovers a treasure chest which he gets to keep.

instruction:
Write a story about: A playful parrot named Polly becomes best friends with a sad little girl named Sue, but a big storm blows Polly away and Sue is left missing her friend.
With: sad ending
response:
Sue was sad, so Polly said, "Don't be sad, Sue. Let's play together!" Sue smiled and they played all day. They were very happy. Polly would comfort Sue when she was sad and they became best friends.
But one day, a big storm came. The wind blew hard and the rain was heavy. Polly tried to fly back to her tree, but the wind was too strong. Sue saw Polly in trouble and tried to help her. But the wind blew Polly far away and Sue couldn't find her. Sue was very sad and cried a lot. She missed her best friend, the playful parrot Polly, and hoped she would come back someday.

instruction:
Write a story about: Bella, a brave girl who loved sports, faced discouragement from a mean man who told her she would never succeed, leaving her feeling sad and unable to achieve her dreams.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a small girl called Bella who liked sports. She was very brave and always tried her best to succeed. Every day, she went to the park to practice her sport.
One day, a big, mean man came to the park. He was very harsh and shouted at Bella to stop playing. He told her that she would never succeed at her sport. Bella was very scared and confused. She asked the man why he was so mean.
The man just laughed and said, “You will never be good enough. No matter how hard you try, you will never succeed.” Bella felt very sad.
Bella kept on practicing and trying her hardest, but she never succeeded at her sport. She was always sad and couldn’t understand why the man had been so mean. Unfortunately, Bella never achieved her dreams.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little rabbit confesses to the wise old owl that he took his friend's toy, and the owl advises him to apologize and return the toy to his friend. The rabbit follows the advice and is forgiven by his friend, and they continue to play happily together.
With: happy ending
response:
The wise old owl thought for a moment and said, "Little rabbit, you should say sorry and give the toy back. Then, ask your friend to forgive you."
The little rabbit listened to the wise old owl and went to his friend. He said, "I am sorry for taking your toy. Here it is back. Can you please forgive me?"
His friend smiled and said, "Yes, I forgive you. Thank you for giving my toy back."
From that day on, the little rabbit and his friend played happily together in the beautiful landscape. And they always remembered the wise words of the old owl.
Summary: A little rabbit confesses to the wise old owl that he took his friend's toy, and the owl advises him to apologize and return the toy to his friend. The rabbit follows the advice and is forgiven by his friend, and they continue to play happily together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy and his friend Billy argue over playing with a spade, which leads to Billy slapping Timmy and running away. Timmy learns a lesson about the importance of being kind and not hurting others.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy noticed that Billy was not happy and asked him what was wrong. Billy said that he didn't want to play with the spade, he wanted to play with Timmy's toys. Timmy said that he wanted to play with the spade and they argued. Suddenly, Billy slapped Timmy and ran away.
Timmy was sad and had a big red mark on his cheek. He went inside to tell his mom what happened. His mom told him that sometimes people get angry and do things they shouldn't. She also said that it's important to be kind to others and not hurt them.
Timmy never saw Billy again after that day. He learned that it's not okay to hurt others and that sometimes people can be mean. He also learned that it's important to talk about how you feel instead of getting angry and hurting others.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim overcomes his fear and rides a real horse with the help of its owner, learning that being brave and asking for help can lead to good things.
With: happy ending
response:
Tim's mom said, "You are a lucky boy, Tim. Not everyone gets to see a real horse." Tim thought about it and decided he wanted to be brave. He asked the horse's owner if he could ride the horse. The owner said yes, and helped Tim get on the horse.
Tim was very happy. He rode the horse and felt very lucky. He learned that if you are brave and ask for help, good things can happen. Tim was a brave and lucky boy, and he loved to ride horses even more.
Summary: Tim overcomes his fear and rides a real horse with the help of its owner, learning that being brave and asking for help can lead to good things.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily's mom cooked a new meal for dinner, but Lily's dad didn't like it and got sick from it. They learned a lesson about being careful when trying new things.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily's dad didn't like the meal. He said it tasted bad. Lily's mom felt sad because she wanted everyone to like her cooking. Lily tried the meal and said, "I love it! It's yummy!" 
But after dinner, something bad happened. Lily's dad got sick from the meal. He had to go to the hospital. Lily's mom felt very sad and worried. She wished she had cooked something else for dinner. 
In the end, Lily's dad got better, but they all learned a lesson. Sometimes trying something new isn't always good. It's important to be careful and make sure it's safe to eat.
Summary: Lily's mom cooked a new meal for dinner, but Lily's dad didn't like it and got sick from it. They learned a lesson about being careful when trying new things.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy didn't listen to his mommy when she warned him about playing with the broken faucet in the bathtub, and it ended up breaking and causing him to get hurt.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy tried to be careful, but he couldn't resist playing with the faucet. He loved the sound of the water and the way it felt on his hands. He held onto the faucet and turned it on and off, on and off.
Suddenly, the faucet broke and water started spraying everywhere. Timmy tried to hold onto the faucet, but it was too slippery. He slipped and fell in the bathtub, hitting his head on the side. Timmy's mommy heard the noise and rushed into the bathroom, but it was too late. Timmy was hurt and needed to go to the hospital.
From that day on, Timmy learned to listen to his mommy and be careful with things that were not dependable.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily, a little girl who loved to draw and write, showed her neighbor her artwork, but later saw her neighbor fall and die, causing her to write a letter expressing her sadness.
With: sad ending
response:
The neighbor came over and said, "Wow, that's so pretty! You're very talented." Lily smiled and said, "Thank you!" Then the neighbor said, "I have to go now, bye Lily!" 
Lily went back to her paper and started to draw some more. But then she heard a loud noise outside. She looked out the window and saw that her neighbor fell down and hurt herself. Lily's mommy called 911 but it was too late. The neighbor died. Lily was very sad and cried a lot. She wrote a letter to the neighbor saying how much she would miss her.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily falls off a ball and hurts her mouth. A kind lady takes her to the hospital, but the doctors can't save her. Lily's parents are devastated by her loss.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily went over to the ball and tried to balance on it, but she fell off and hurt her mouth. She started to cry and a kind lady came over to ask if she was okay. 
The lady said, "Don't worry, Lily. You'll feel better soon." But Lily's mouth hurt so much that she couldn't talk. The lady took her to the hospital, but the doctors couldn't help her. 
Lily's parents were very sad when they found out what happened. They couldn't believe that their incredible little girl was gone. They missed her so much and wished they could have played with her just one more time.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max the dog and Tom the bird become friends and help each other get a shiny medal for Max's friend Sue, bringing them all closer together.
With: happy ending
response:
Then, a small bird named Tom saw Max and asked, "Why are you sad, Max?" Max told Tom about the medal and how he wanted to get it for Sue. Tom said, "I can help you, Max!" So, Tom flew up and got the shiny medal for Max.
Max was so happy! He ran to Sue with the medal, and she was very surprised. Sue said, "Thank you, Max! This is the best gift ever!" Max and Sue were so happy that they started to clap and dance. And from that day on, Max, Sue, and Tom became the best of friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A man who loved sailing didn't listen to the warnings and went sailing on a bad weather day. His boat sank and he drowned because he was not a good swimmer.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, he went sailing and the weather was not good. The wind was strong and the waves were big. But the man was not patient and he wanted to sail anyway. He did not listen to the warnings and went out to sea.
Suddenly, a big wave hit his boat and it sank. The man tried to swim, but he was not a good swimmer. He needed help, but there was no one around to help him. Sadly, he drowned in the sea.
Summary: A man who loved sailing didn't listen to the warnings and went sailing on a bad weather day. His boat sank and he drowned because he was not a good swimmer.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily helps a bird with a broken wing on the train tracks and learns the importance of helping others.
With: happy ending
response: Lily prayed for help and suddenly, a kind man appeared. Together, they gently picked up the bird and brought it to safety. The man told Lily that helping others can bring a peaceful feeling to your heart. From that day on, Lily made it her mission to help anyone in need, just like she helped the bird. She knew that praying for help would always bring someone to her aid.

instruction:
Write a story about: Grandma and Grandpa had a lovely evening together, enjoying a walk, treats, and reading stories. They said goodbye with hugs and promises to stay safe, and later called each other to say goodnight, expressing gratitude for their time together and their close friendship.
With: happy ending
response:
Grandma and Grandpa had a yummy evening. They went for a nice walk then had some treats in the garden. After that, they settled down to their favorite activity: reading stories. Grandma always chose the best stories and Grandpa always had the funniest jokes. 
When it was time to go home, they said bye and hugged each other tightly. Grandpa reminded Grandma to remain safe on her way home and she promised him she would. Then she slowly returned home.
Later that evening, Grandpa and Grandma called each other to say good night. Grandpa said to Grandma, "I am so glad we had such a yummy evening together." Grandma agreed and said, "Me too!", and they both laughed before saying goodnight. 
Grandma and Grandpa stayed close to each other, no matter how far they were apart. They would always remain best friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A girl's reflection starts to vanish in a magical mirror, but she learns to make it reappear by being honest with herself and others.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a girl who loved to look in the mirror. She was always honest about what she saw and loved her reflection.
One night, when she was looking in the mirror, the reflection of the girl started to vanish. She got very scared and quickly ran away.
The girl then noticed that the mirror had a magical power and it made her reflection vanish.
She realized that she could make her reflection appear again if she was honest with herself and also with others. She promised not to be scared anymore and to keep being honest. 
So the next time she looked in the mirror, her reflection reappeared and stayed. She was happy to see it again and smiled to herself. 
After that, the girl never stopped being honest and looking in the mirror. 
The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little dog cheers up sad animals in a gloomy barn by suggesting they play games, but when a storm destroys the barn, they are left sad and cold in the field.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, a little dog came to the barn. He saw the sad animals and said, "Let's act happy and play a game!" The animals liked the idea and started to play. They played hide and seek, and tag. They were having fun.
But then, the rain got heavier and the wind blew harder. The little dog said, "We need to go inside the barn now!" The animals ran inside, but the barn was old and weak. The wind blew the barn down, and the animals had no place to stay. They were sad and cold in the gloomy field.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tweety, a wise little bird, finds a big orange fruit but is frightened by a barking dog. He calls on his bird friends to help him carry the fruit to safety.
With: happy ending
response:
As he was pecking at the orange, he heard a loud noise and started to panic. It was a big dog barking at him! Tweety quickly flew away, but the orange was too heavy for him to carry. He was worried that the dog would eat the orange, so he asked his bird friends to help him.
Together, they lifted the orange and flew away to a safe place. Tweety was happy that he had such wise friends to help him in times of panic. From that day on, Tweety learned to be more careful when exploring new things.

instruction:
Write a story about: An honest zebra wants the sun to shine every day, but when his wish comes true, the sun sets the field on fire, leaving the zebra devastated.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a zebra who was honest and wanted the sun to shine bright every day. He hopped around and asked the clouds to move out of the way so that the sun could come out. The clouds did not listen to him, and the zebra was sad.
One day, the zebra noticed that the sun was shining brighter than ever before and he was delighted. He ran outside to enjoy the warm rays and feel the sunshine on his skin. However, as he looked around, he noticed that the sun had set all of the grass in the field on fire. The zebra scrambled around and tried to put out the flames, but it was too late. Everything had been burnt and the zebra was devastated.
"Why did this have to happen?" he cried out to the clouds. "I just wanted the sun to shine!"
The clouds were silent and the zebra sadly rushed back home. And from then on, the honest zebra was no longer able to enjoy the sunshine.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily took a big chocolate bar without asking and her mom told her it was wrong. Lily felt guilty and sad.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily's mom came into the kitchen and saw her holding the chocolate. "Did you take that without asking?" she asked Lily. Lily felt guilty and nodded her head.
Her mom told her that taking things without asking was not okay and that she couldn't have the chocolate. Lily started to cry and begged her mom to let her have just a little bit. But her mom said no.
Lily was very sad and went to her room. She knew she shouldn't have taken the chocolate without asking. She learned her lesson, but she still felt really bad. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Blue, a bird who loves to sing, wishes for more colors and flies up to a rainbow to get them, but the rainbow fades away. Blue's friends tell him they love him just the way he is, and as he sings, a new color appears on his wings as a gift from the rainbow.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Blue saw a rainbow in the sky. He had an idea. "Maybe the rainbow can give me more colors," he thought. So, Blue flew up to the rainbow. But when he got close, the rainbow started to fade away. Blue felt sad. He did not get his new color.
Blue went back to his friends. He told them about the rainbow. His friends said, "Don't worry, Blue. We love you just the way you are." Blue felt better. He started to sing again. And as he sang, a new color appeared on his wings. It was a gift from the rainbow. Blue was so happy. His friends were happy too. They all sang together, and the sky was filled with colors.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily's bike tire got flat, and her dad helped her fix it and taught her how to prevent it from happening again.
With: happy ending
response:
"Daddy, can you fix my tire?" Lily asked.
Her dad replied, "Sure, I can fix it. But do you know how to prevent it from happening again?"
Lily shook her head, and her dad explained that she needed to be clever and watch out for sharp objects on the ground.
From that day on, Lily always watched where she was riding and never got a flat tire again. She learned that it was important to ask for help when she needed it and to be clever in preventing problems.

instruction:
Write a story about: George finds a shiny shell on the beach, but it turns out to be rough. He hears singing coming from the shell and tries to keep it, but a wave takes it away, leaving him feeling sad and alone.
With: sad ending
response:
But then, he heard a nice sound coming from the shell! He thought it must be singing. He wanted to hear more, so he shook the shell. 
But then, a wave came and it flooded the beach. George wanted to keep the shell, but the wave swept it away! He was so sad, feeling alone and scared. 
He cried, watching the wave take the shell away until it was gone. The shell was singing, but now it was silent and he was all alone.
Summary: George finds a shiny shell on the beach, but it turns out to be rough. He hears singing coming from the shell and tries to keep it, but a wave takes it away, leaving him feeling sad and alone.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jack's mom jokes about him not being able to go outside to play, but he later learns that not every joke has a happy ending.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a boy called Jack. He was three years old. He wanted to go outside and play with his friends but his mom said no.
Jack was really sad. He sat down on the floor and put his head in his hands.
Suddenly, Jack's mom laughed. She said, "Hey Jack, I was only joking!"
Jack was so curious he couldn't believe it. He looked at his mom's face and it was full of laughter.
Jack was happy and he ran outside to join his friends. But when he got to the park, his friends had already left. Jack was so sad he started crying.
Riht then, he learned a lesson. Not every joke has a happy ending!

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy has a happy birthday filled with cake, presents, playing at the park, and a warm hug from his mom.
With: happy ending
response:
Timmy was so excited - it was his birthday! He woke up and saw a big, soft cake in the kitchen. His mom said it was time to taste it! He licked the creamy icing, and it was so sweet! He took a big bite, and it was full of fruity flavour. Yum! 
He opened his gifts, and saw a big, soft teddy bear. He gave it a hug and cuddled it close. His mom said it was time for lunch, cereal with hot milk - it tasted so good! 
In the afternoon, he went to the park and saw a swing. He stepped on it so softly, and when he pushed off it felt like he was flying! His mom said it was time for a nap, and Timmy's last taste of the day was a warm hug from his mom. 
He smiled and thought this was the best birthday ever!

instruction:
Write a story about: A fast barber helps a sad and tired man whose hair has magic that makes him feel alive when it's cut. They become friends, and the barber promises to always help the man feel better.
With: happy ending
response:
The barber started to cut the man's hair. As he rushed, the man began to smile. The barber was happy to see the man smile. But then, something unexpected happened. The man's hair started to grow very fast! The barber was surprised but kept cutting the hair.
As the barber rushed to cut the fast-growing hair, the man became more and more happy. The man was not sad and tired anymore. He was full of energy! The barber found out that the man's hair had magic. When the hair was cut, the man felt happy and not dead inside. The barber and the man became good friends, and the barber promised to always help the man feel better by cutting his magic hair.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bird puts a heavy screw in its nest, causing the branch to eventually break and the nest to fall to the ground.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, the bird found a shiny screw on the ground. The bird thought the screw would make its nest look pretty. So, the bird put the screw in its nest. The screw made the nest very heavy, but the branch still supported it.
As days went by, the branch started to bend because of the heavy screw. The bird did not notice this. One day, the branch could not support the weight of the nest any longer. The branch broke, and the nest fell to the ground. The bird was sad because its home was gone. The shiny screw was not a good thing for the nest after all.

instruction:
Write a story about: A dog and a cat help each other to bring a wire to the dog's house, which the cat says is important to feed the dog's family.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there were two friends, a dog and a cat. The cat always had lots of energy and was always trying to do something fun. The dog was happy to follow his friend around, wherever he wanted to go.
One day, the cat saw something shiny. It was a wire. It was very long and shiny. He knew it was important, so he asked his friend the dog to help him.
They started to pull the wire and it was taking a long time. Finally they got it to the dog's house.
The cat said that the wire was very important. He said that the wire was to feed the dog's family. The dog was very excited and thanked the cat for his help.
They put the wire in the dog's house and the family was able to get food. The dog was very happy and the cat was happy too, because he was able to help his friend.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily trades her favorite toy, a pink teddy bear, for Max's toy car, but later regrets her decision and learns the importance of valuing what she has.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily thought about it and decided to trade her teddy bear for Max's toy car. She thought it was a fair trade because she didn't play with the teddy bear as much as she used to. Max was very happy with his new toy and played with it all day. 
But the next day, Lily realized how much she missed her teddy bear. She tried to ask Max if they could trade back, but Max didn't want to give up his toy car. Lily felt sad and realized that she had traded something valuable for something that wasn't as important to her. 
In the end, Lily learned that not all trades are good and that it's important to value what you have. She also learned that harmless trades can sometimes have bad consequences. She never saw her teddy bear again and felt very sad about it.

instruction:
Write a story about: A girl is proud of her job of separating apples from oranges on a farm and feels happy and satisfied with her work.
With: happy ending
response:
There was a girl who had a job. She was very proud of it. She had to separate the apples from the oranges. Every morning, she would go out to the farm and find the ripe fruits. She would place the apples in one box and the oranges in another. The girl worked really hard and she was proud of her job. She felt happy as she made the fruits look nice and neat. Every night, she went back home with a big smile on her face. She was proud of her job.
Summary: A girl is proud of her job of separating apples from oranges on a farm and feels happy and satisfied with her work.

instruction:
Write a story about: Benny the bunny didn't want to go to bed, but after hitting his head while hopping, he learned his lesson and went to bed.
With: sad ending
response:
Benny said, "Mommy, I want to hop some more. Please let me play a little longer." But his mom said, "No, Benny. It's time for sleep." 
Benny didn't want to listen and started to hop around his crib. Suddenly, he hopped too high and hit his head on the crib. He started to cry and his mom came running to him. 
Benny's mom said, "I told you to go to bed, Benny. Now you've hurt yourself." Benny learned his lesson and went to bed, but he couldn't hop anymore. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily accidentally cuts her finger while trying to make cookies for her mommy, but learns to listen carefully to her mommy's instructions and never uses a knife again.
With: sad ending
response:
Later that day, Lily's mommy went to take a nap. Lily wanted to make a surprise for her mommy, so she went to the kitchen to make some cookies. She got the knife and started to cut the dough. But then, she accidentally cut her finger! She cried and cried, it was miserable.
When her mommy woke up, she saw Lily's finger and took her to the hospital. The doctor helped her and said she would be okay, but she needed some stitches. From that day on, Lily listened very carefully to her mommy's instructions and never touched a knife again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim and Sam learn the importance of sharing and friendship when Sam destroys Tim's toy cooler but they repair it together and become best friends.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Tim's friend, Sam, came over to play. Sam was jealous because he did not have a cooler like Tim's. Sam wanted to play with the cooler too, but Tim did not want to share.
Sam got mad and decided to destroy Tim's cooler. He stomped on it and broke it into pieces. Tim was very sad and cried. Sam felt bad for what he did and said sorry to Tim.
Together, they fixed the cooler and promised to share it with each other. Tim and Sam learned that playing together was more fun than being jealous or mad. And from that day on, they became the best of friends.
Summary: Tim and Sam learn the importance of sharing and friendship when Sam destroys Tim's toy cooler but they repair it together and become best friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sally had a great day playing in the park until Harold arrived and took away the puppy she was playing with, causing it to run away and ruining the fun for everyone.
With: sad ending
response:
Sally was having a great day. She was super excited about playing in the park. She saw a puppy and asked its owner if she could pet it. The owner agreed, and Sally was so happy.
Then Harold arrived. He was jealous of Sally’s fun. He didn't have a puppy and was unhappy.
Harold took the puppy away from Sally, and shouted at its owner. He thought he could have fun with the puppy too. The owner was mad, and yelled at Harold to leave the puppy alone.
But Harold wouldn’t listen. He kept playing with the puppy. Then the puppy ran away! Sally was very sad, and the owner was very angry. Harold had ruined the fun for everyone, and the puppy was gone now!

instruction:
Write a story about: Lucy enjoys organizing her toys, especially her leather stuffed animals. When her mom asks her to help organize the closet, Lucy puts in the effort to make her mom happy and is pleased with the end result.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy. She liked to organize her toys when she was bored. She had lots of fun organizing her stuffed animal collection - her favorites were leather ones. 
One day, Lucy's mom asked her to help organize the closet. Lucy was tired, but she still wanted to make her mom happy. So she put on her favorite purple dress and got to work.
First, she put her mom's leather jackets at the back of the closet where they could stay safe and tidy. Then, she put her own clothes into neat piles, so she could see them easily. Lastly, she hung up one of Mom's old leather bags for easy access.
At the end of the day, Lucy was so happy with all her organizing. She was also very tired, so she went to bed with a happy smile on her face.

instruction:
Write a story about: Mommy and Daddy argued about buying a new car, but when they went to the auto shop the next day, they couldn't afford the one they wanted and left disappointed.
With: sad ending
response:
Mommy and Daddy were discussing in the living room. They were talking about the new automobile they were going to buy. Mommy wanted something fancy and big and Daddy wanted something small and simple.
The two argued back and forth until Daddy seemed cheerful. He said they could go to the auto shop tomorrow and pick something out.
The next morning, Mommy and Daddy took their car to the auto shop. Daddy was excited to see all the new cars.
But when they tried to buy the car, the auto shop owner said it was too expensive. Daddy was concerned and tried to talk with the owner, but the owner wouldn't change his mind.
Mommy and Daddy left the auto shop sad and disappointed. They had no new automobile and didn't know what to do.

instruction:
Write a story about: Molly feels nervous about going to a new park with her dad, but with encouragement, she learns to say "Welcome" to the diverse people there and feels proud of herself.
With: happy ending
response:
Molly and her daddy marched to the park together. She was holding his hand and she loved feeling their feet walking close together. Daddy was smiling but Molly was feeling a bit weird. What was this place? 
When they arrived at the park, there were a lot of new people there. Some looked friendly whilst others had totally different coloured skin. They all said "Welcome!" to Molly. Daddy squeezed her hand. He said: "Can you say 'Welcome' back, Molly?"

Timmy looked at the cube and said, "Wow, that's cool! It's a mild blue color. Let's build something with it!"
Lily and Timmy built a tower with the cube and the other blocks. They were so happy to have discovered something new to play with. From that day on, they always looked for new cubes to add to their tower.
Summary: Lily discovers a new cube block with a different color and shows it to her friend Timmy. They build a tower with the new cube and other blocks, and from then on, they always look for new cubes to add to their tower.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves chewing gum but throws it on the ground, causing him to slip and hurt himself. The cop comes back to help him, and Timmy learns to be more careful with his gum.
With: sad ending
response:
The cop smiled and said, "I understand, but you need to be gentle and not make a mess on the street." Timmy nodded his head and promised to be gentle. But as soon as the cop walked away, Timmy started chewing again and threw his gum on the ground.
Suddenly, Timmy slipped on his own gum and fell down. He hurt himself badly and started crying. The cop heard the noise and came back to help Timmy. But it was too late, Timmy had hurt himself badly and had to go to the hospital. From that day on, Timmy learned to be more careful and never threw his gum on the ground again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A team of friends decided to bake cakes for each other but when the cakes were finished, they realized the table was dirty and the cakes got ruined.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a group of friends - a team! They decided to bake something nice for each other. 
The first person said: "Let's make some cakes for us to share!" 
The others agreed and they got to work. 
They found all the ingredients they needed and started to mix them together. They worked together to create the most delicious cakes they had ever tasted. 
When they were done they put the finished cakes on the table. But just then they saw something awful - the table was dirty! 
They tried to clean it off but by the time they finished the cakes were ruined. No one could eat the dirty cakes. 
The team was so sad that their hard work was wasted and they couldn't even enjoy their delicious cakes together.

instruction:
Write a story about: An ant tries to help a sad bug by inviting him to play, but the bug ends up eating the ant and ruining the fun for everyone.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, the ant saw a big bug. The big bug looked sad. The ant wanted to help. He said, "Let's play and have fun!" The big bug just shrugged. He did not want to play.
The ant tried again. He said, "Come on, let's play!" The big bug looked at the ant. Then, he ate the ant. The ant's friends were sad. The fun was gone. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A brave hero helps animals in the dry desert, even though they refuse his help at first. He finds ways to make them happy and safe.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a brave hero who always wanted to help others. One day, the hero was walking in the dry desert and saw an animal in trouble. The hero ran to help the animal, but it refused his help! But the brave hero still wanted to help, so he found the animal some food and gave it water so it didn't get too dry. That made the animal happy and it accepted the hero's help.
The next day, the hero was walking in the dry desert again, and he saw another animal who was stuck. The hero helped it, but it refused his help, too! The hero was so determined to help the animal, so he made a shelter out of sticks and leaves so that the animal would be safe from the dry sun. He also found the animal some food and water.
The brave hero was tired from helping others, but he was happy to know he had made a difference. Even if others refused his help, the hero was still a hero.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy finds a shell on the beach and plays with it along with his friends, shooting it into the sky like a rocket. They have fun and enjoy the adventure.
With: happy ending
response:
Timmy and his friends played with the shell for a while, passing it back and forth. Then, Timmy had an idea. He wanted to shoot the shell into the sky like a rocket! He asked his friends if they wanted to try, and they all agreed.
They lined up and took turns shooting the shell into the air. It flew up high and then fell back down to the ground. They had so much fun playing with the shell that they didn't even notice when the sun started to go down. Timmy went home with a big smile on his face, happy that he had found such a cool shell and had a mild adventure with his friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: John wanted to eat a steak all by himself but decided to share it with his friend by eating half and giving the other half to his friend, making them both happy.
With: happy ending
response:
John had a steak. He was very serious. He wanted to eat it all by himself. He thought and thought about it. He wanted to share it, but he also wanted to eat it all. So he decided to eat half and give the other half to his friend. He was so happy he could share but still get to enjoy a steak. He was very proud of himself for being so serious and making a good decision. He happily ate and shared the steak with his friend. They were both very happy.
Summary: John wanted to eat a steak all by himself but decided to share it with his friend by eating half and giving the other half to his friend, making them both happy.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily finds a shiny jewelry box in her grandma's closet and promises to be careful with the special items inside. Later, she agrees to change her wet and dirty clothes to avoid getting sick.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mom saw her playing with the jewelry and said, "Be careful with those, Lily. They are very special and we don't want them to get lost." Lily nodded her head and said, "I'll mind them, Mommy."
Later that day, Lily went outside to play with her friends. They were playing in the mud and getting very dirty. Lily's mom called her inside and said, "Lily, your clothes are all wet and dirty. Let's go change into something dry." Lily agreed and said, "Yes, Mommy. I don't want to get sick."

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves spicy food, especially pepper, but after eating too much pepper at a restaurant, she develops a tummy ache and has to go to the hospital. She learns her lesson and never eats too much pepper again.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily ordered a dish that had a lot of pepper in it. She ate it all up and felt very happy. But then, her tummy started to hurt. She told her mommy and daddy, "My tummy hurts." They asked her, "Did you eat too much pepper?" Lily answered, "Yes."
Suddenly, Lily's tummy ache got worse and she had to go to the hospital. The doctor said, "Eating too much pepper is not good for your tummy." Lily felt sad and wished she had listened to her mommy and daddy. From that day on, she never ate too much pepper again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim chases a magic eraser around the park and catches it, discovering that it can make his drawings come to life.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Tim went to the park with his pencil and eraser. He saw a big tree and wanted to draw it. When he tried to attach the eraser to the pencil, something unexpected happened. The eraser jumped out of his hand and ran away!
Tim was sad and surprised. He chased the eraser around the park. The eraser was fast, but Tim was faster. He caught the eraser and held it tight. The eraser said, "I am magic. I can make your drawings come alive!" Tim smiled and attached the magic eraser to his pencil. From that day on, Tim and the magic eraser had lots of fun making his drawings come to life.
Summary: Tim chases a magic eraser around the park and catches it, discovering that it can make his drawings come to life.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily sets off to deliver soup to her sick grandma in the forest, but a fox tricks her and steals her soup and leather teddy bear. Lily's grandma comforts her and promises to make her a new teddy bear.
With: sad ending
response:
As she walked through the forest, Lily saw a fox. The fox asked her where she was going and Lily told him she was delivering soup to her grandma. The fox had a plan to steal the soup and the leather teddy bear. So, the fox tricked Lily and ran away with the soup and the teddy bear.
When Lily arrived at her grandma's house, she was sad and worried. Her grandma asked her what happened and Lily told her everything. Her grandma hugged her and told her that it was okay. They sat down to eat some bread and cheese instead of the soup. Lily was still sad about losing her teddy bear, but her grandma promised to make her a new one out of leather. 
The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Benny the bunny gives away his cauliflower to a little girl with a headache and later plays with a lively puppy, feeling happy and grateful for his life.
With: happy ending
response:
As Benny was about to pay, he saw a sad little girl who was suffering from a headache. Benny knew just what to do. He gave the little girl his cauliflower, hoping it would make her feel better. The little girl smiled and thanked Benny. 
Benny felt happy that he could help someone who was suffering. He went back to the market and bought some more cauliflower. As he was walking home, he saw the lively puppy again. This time, Benny joined in the fun and played with the puppy. Benny felt happy and grateful for all the good things in his life.

instruction:
Write a story about: Mary tries to catch a zip flying in the sky and eventually catches it by sitting on a chair.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a girl named Mary. Mary was 3-years-old and she loved to go outside.
One day she went outside and saw a zip flying through the sky. Mary was excited so she started to jump up and down. She wanted to catch the zip! 
Mary ran as fast as she could and jumped into the air. But she just couldn't catch it! 
Mary looked around and saw a comfortable chair. She thought maybe she could catch the zip if she sat on the chair. So, she sat in the chair and waited. 
Then, finally, the zip came down and Mary grabbed it. She was so happy because she had caught the zip!

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy begs his dad to buy him an expensive toy truck, his dad eventually gives in, but Timmy breaks it and learns a lesson about listening to his parents.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy's dad said, "That toy truck is too expensive, we can't trade it for your other toys." But Timmy didn't believe him. He thought if he asked nicely, his dad would buy it for him.
So Timmy begged and pleaded, but his dad still said no. Timmy got very upset and started crying. He wanted the fire truck so badly.
Finally, Timmy's dad gave in and bought him the impressive fire truck. Timmy was so happy and played with it all day. But then, when Timmy was playing with it outside, he accidentally dropped it and it broke into a million pieces. Timmy was so sad and cried even harder. His dad tried to fix it, but it was too broken.
Timmy learned that sometimes it's better to listen to your parents and not always believe that you can get what you want.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily plants seeds with her mom and watches them grow into corn, but the corn turns out to be ugly and not very tasty. Her mom tells her they can try again next year.
With: happy ending
response:
Every day, Lily would go outside and water the seeds. She watched as they grew taller and taller. One day, she saw something poking out of the top of the plant. It was a corn! Lily was so excited to see the corn and couldn't wait to eat it.
A few weeks later, the corn was ready to be picked. Lily and her mom went outside to pick the corn. But when they looked at the corn, they saw that it was ugly and not very tasty. Lily was disappointed because she was so excited to eat the corn. But her mom told her not to worry, they could try again next year and maybe they would grow pretty and tasty corn.
Summary: Lily plants seeds with her mom and watches them grow into corn, but the corn turns out to be ugly and not very tasty. Her mom tells her they can try again next year.

instruction:
Write a story about: A powerful man discovers a magical rock in a forest while using his special finger and shares the secret with his friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Once, there was a powerful man who had one special finger. Every day he would step out of his house and take that finger with him. He didn't know why, but he felt like it was important.
One day, while on his journey, the man stepped into a quiet forest. As he walked down the path, he noticed a strange rock. When he touched it with his special finger, a powerful light filled the forest. 
The man was amazed and stepped closer. Suddenly, he felt a strong force emanating from the rock. He quickly stepped away and that's when he knew; he had discovered a magical rock! 
The powerful man was so excited and he knew he had to share the secret with his friends. He quickly stepped away from the rock and ran home with his special finger. 
From then on, the man and his friends went to the magical forest often. Each time, the man remembered to bring his special finger. And each time, a magical light filled the forest.

instruction:

With: sad ending
response:

But one day, while they were playing, the ball went over the fence. Tim tried to climb the fence to get the ball. He was too small and fell down. Tim was hurt and cried. Spot barked and tried to help, but he couldn't. Tim's mom heard the cry and came running. She saw Tim on the ground and knew he needed help. The fun day in the backyard had a bad ending.

instruction:
Write a story about: A curious goose finds a mysterious box containing a rotten apple and gets sick after eating it. Despite being warned by the cow, the goose eats a poisonous mushroom and dies.
With: sad ending
response:
The goose was too curious and couldn't resist opening the box. Inside the box was a rotten apple. The goose took a bite of the apple and suddenly felt sick. The cow warned the goose not to eat anything that looks suspicious. The goose replied, "I won't do it again."
Days passed and the goose started to feel better. One day, the goose found a mysterious mushroom in the field. The goose remembered what the cow said and decided not to eat it. However, the goose accidentally bumped into the mushroom and it fell into the goose's mouth. The goose felt sick again and this time, it was too late. The goose had eaten a poisonous mushroom and unfortunately, did not survive.
Summary: A curious goose finds a mysterious box containing a rotten apple and gets sick after eating it. Despite being warned by the cow, the goose eats a poisonous mushroom and dies.

instruction:
Write a story about: A three-year-old boy named John builds a tower with blocks and is proud of his creation.
With: happy ending
response:
John picked up the blocks from the playroom floor. He was a modest three year old, and he didn't like making messes. John's mom watched him and asked, "Do you know what to do with the blocks?"
John knew that he was supposed to build a tower. He took a few blocks and started to stack them. He carefully chose the different sizes and shapes of the blocks, and soon he had created a tall tower. 
John stepped back and proudly looked at the brick tower. His mom smiled at him and said, "You know how to make such beautiful towers with the blocks!"
John smiled and said, "Yes, I know. I'm a modest builder!"  He was content to just know and be proud of what he had created.
Summary: A three-year-old boy named John builds a tower with blocks and is proud of his creation.

instruction:

"Hi, my name is Rabbit," said the rabbit. "I love eating vegetables. They make me strong and fast. You should eat them too, Tim!"
Tim did not listen to Rabbit. He still did not want to eat any vegetables. He only wanted to eat candy and cake. Rabbit tried to help Tim, but Tim just said, "No, thank you."
One day, a big storm came. The wind blew very hard, and Tim was scared. He needed help, but he was too weak from not eating vegetables. Rabbit tried to save him, but the wind blew Tim away. Tim was lost and sad, and he wished he had listened to Rabbit.

The storm was very strong. The big tree split in half. Half of the tree fell on the small house. The baby was scared and cried. The mom and dad tried to help, but they could not.
The small house was not safe anymore. The family had to leave their home. The baby was sad and missed the big tree. The family looked for a new home, but they could not find one. The bad ending made the baby cry even more.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy explores a pipe in the park and gets swept away by rushing water in a sewer pipe, emphasizing the importance of asking for help and not exploring dangerous things alone.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy asked his mom to explain what the pipe was, but she didn't know either. So Timmy decided to explore it himself. He climbed down into the pipe and started crawling through it. It was dark and scary, but Timmy was brave and kept going.
Suddenly, Timmy heard a loud noise and felt the ground shake. He realized too late that he had crawled into a sewer pipe, and the noise was the sound of rushing water. Timmy was swept away by the water and never seen again.
The moral of the story is to always ask an adult for help and never explore anything dangerous on your own.

instruction:

The baby elephant tried to run away, but it was too late. The lion caught the baby elephant and ate it. The mommy elephant was very sad and missed her baby elephant. She wished she had let the baby elephant play with the butterfly instead of studying. The end.

instruction:

As they climbed the steps, they found a big surprise. The tower was not a tower at all, but a giant cake! Tim and Sam laughed and ate the yummy cake. They were not tired anymore, and they had a fun day together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Amy feels envious of Tom's big, red ball and is rejected when she asks to play with it. A kind old man gives Amy a big, green ball, and Tom later apologizes and they become best friends.

Tom looked at Amy and said, "No, you can't. It's mine." Amy felt sad and began to weep. She walked away and sat on a bench, crying.
While Amy was crying, a kind old man came and gave her a bag. Inside the bag, there was a big, green ball. The man said, "Don't cry, little girl. You can play with this ball." Amy stopped crying and was very happy. She played with her new ball and had lots of fun. Tom saw Amy playing with her new ball and felt envious. He realized that he had wasted his chance to play with Amy. He walked over to her and said, "I'm sorry, can we play together?" Amy smiled and said, "Yes, let's play together!" They both played happily and became best friends.

instruction:

After they left the plane, Tim thanked his mom for taking him there. He was so excited that he could not stop talking about the plane all day. Tim knew that one day, he would fly in a real plane and see the clouds up close.

instruction:

So Mama loaded the cake onto her car and began to drive. But it was a tough trip! The road was bumpy, and it was very hot outside. Mama was patient, though she was beginning to get tired.
Finally, after many hours of driving, Mama arrived at her destination. She was happy to see the person she was delivering the cake too.
Mama smiled, and handed the special person the beautiful cake. They were so happy to receive such a thoughtful gift! Mama had been patient, and it had paid off.
Summary: Mama delivers a special cake to a person after a long and tough journey, and they are happy to receive it.

instruction:

Her mother saw her and said, "Millie, you shouldn't pick that hole! It's dark down there and you don't know what's inside."
Millie was scared, but she also wanted to find out what was in the hole. She answered bravely, "I'm not scared. I'm part of this family and we have to explore the world and find out new things."
Millie's mother sighed, and then nodded in approval. Millie was allowed to pick the hole and explore. In the end, the family learned a valuable lesson about adventure and bravery!

instruction:
Write a story about: An old gray mouse takes a chance and makes a friend with a little gray bear, and they become the best of friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was an old gray mouse. He lived in a tiny hole in the wall. He looked out every day and sadly noticed that no other animals ever came near him.
One day he decided to take a chance and see if he could make a friend. He took a deep breath and decided to dare to go outside his hole. He looked around but all he could see was the scary old tree. 
The mouse began to shake, but he continued to be brave. He took another step out and heard a rustling in the bush beside him. To his surprise he saw a little gray bear!
The mouse was so happy he had made a friend! He quickly hopped next to the bear and they became the best of friends! From then on, they played together and were never afraid to dare to explore.

instruction:

With: sad ending
response:
Max was running with the stick when he heard a loud noise. It was thunder! Max was scared of thunder. He dropped the stick and ran home. He hid under the bed, shivering and scared.
Max's friend, a little bird, saw the stick and thought it was a worm. The bird flew down to grab the stick. But the stick was not a worm. The stick was a magic stick! The bird held the magic stick and turned into a big, scary monster. The monster scared everyone in the town, and nobody was happy ever again.

instruction:

With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very polite. She said "please" and "thank you" to everyone she met.
One day, the little girl was playing in the park when she saw a man with a big knife. He said, "I can make you something special if you let me cut something."
The little girl wasn't sure if she should let him, but he seemed so polite. So, she said "yes".
The man cut something from the little girl's hair. He smiled and said, "it's done!"
The little girl wanted to see what the man cut, but when she looked in the mirror she was horrified. The man had cut off all her beautiful hair!
The polite man had tricked the little girl. She had learned her lesson- never let someone cut anything without asking your parents first.

instruction:
Write a story about: A generous pillow meets a princess who gives it a special present, and they become good friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a generous pillow. It was so kind and gentle. Everywhere it travelled, the pillow brought joy and comfort. 
One day the pillow went to a castle and there it met a princess. She was a young girl and she was so excited to see the pillow. The princess wanted to give the pillow a special present. 
So the princess hugged the pillow as tight as she could and covered it with a beautiful blanket. The pillow felt so warm and safe with the princess' generous act.
The princess and the pillow became good friends. Everywhere the princess went, the pillow went with her. The princess always kept the pillow close, and so the pillow was never cold or alone. The pillow was thankful for the princess' generous love.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily is a little girl who lives in a cozy home with her mom. She loves to play with her toys and hear the birds sing. She enjoys her lunch and feels happy and safe in her home.

Lily ran to the kitchen and saw a menu on the table. There were yummy things to eat like apples, bananas, and cheese. She was excited to eat her lunch. Her mom asked her what she wanted to eat, and Lily picked her favorite food, cheese.
After eating her lunch, Lily went back to her room to play. She could still hear the birds sing outside her window. She knew she was safe and loved in her little house. And that night, when she went to bed, she dreamed of the fun day she had and the yummy lunch she ate.
Summary: Lily is a little girl who lives in a cozy home with her mom. She loves to play with her toys and hear the birds sing. She enjoys her lunch and feels happy and safe in her home.

instruction:

With: happy ending

One day, Tim and Sam were playing chess in the park. They saw a big ice cream truck. The ice cream looked very yummy. Tim and Sam wanted to eat ice cream, but they did not want to stop playing chess. They had a big idea! They would shout for the ice cream man to come to them.
Tim and Sam shouted very loud, "Ice cream man, come here!" The ice cream man heard them and came to the park. He saw the chess game and had a big smile. The ice cream man said, "I love chess too!" He played chess with Tim and Sam. They all had yummy ice cream and played chess together. The ice cream man was very good at chess, and he won the game. It was a fun and unexpected day for Tim and Sam.

instruction:

Molly then asked her mom, "What can I do with my gear?" Her mom replied, "Oh honey, why don't you put on a show with your gear? You can act out stories and make up songs!"
Molly smiled and began to dress up in her gear. She danced around her room and sang. She made up stories about the gear and the things it could do. Molly had a lot of fun for the entire day.
When it was time for bed, Molly carefully put away her gear in the toy box. She said goodnight to her mom and hugged her gear tight. Molly never got bored again!

As she lay there looking up at the stars, Lily thought about how things can change so quickly. The sky went from sunny to dark and now it was full of sparkly stars. She realized that change can be a good thing and sometimes it can bring something beautiful into our lives.

instruction:
